arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Guarnieri argued the deadline is mandatory but the consequence is the real issue.
Justice Gorsuch asked how the harmless error rule applies to this specific violation.
Chief Justice Roberts suggested the court could simply issue the late notice to fix the error.
